title: Why adults who call parents every day may still be emotionally independent
description: Regularly reaching out to parents may reveal a deep emotional attachment, not mere dependence. Depending on cultural backgrounds, the significance of frequent communication is viewed differently. Maturity involves fostering supportive relationships that enhance both autonomy and connection without severing important ties.

The growth is further fueled by increasing office space availability and strong demand from multinational firms, making the REIT landscape a compelling investment option for individuals and institutions alike.

title: T'gana lecturer kills engineering student after she befriended another man
description: In a tragic turn of events, 20-year-old engineering student Tandhra Akshitharani was reportedly killed by her former lecturer, Jetty Naveen Kumar. Following revelations of her sexual exploitation by colleague Bommakanthi Ravikumar, she was coerced into ingesting pesticide. Attempting to disguise the act as a suicide, Kumar fled after alerting her father. Sadly, Akshitharani succumbed to her injuries at a government hospital, with both Kumar and Ravikumar now in police custody.

title: Bank stopped widow from accessing matured FDs; commission orders Rs 13.87L payment
description: A cooperative bank in Kerala restricted a woman's withdrawals after her fixed deposits matured and were transferred. The woman needed the funds for her mother's medical treatment and gold loan repayment. Despite the bank's claims of irregularities, the district consumer commission found they provided inadequate justification. The commission awarded the woman Rs 13.87 lakh and additional compensation for her distress.

description: According to recent Ministry of Railways data released, about 54,600 km of railway tracks were renewed between 2014 and February 2026, with track renewal and upgrading being carried out based on factors such as the age, traffic load and condition of the track.

title: 'Differing views normal part of deliberation': EC responds after report flags rift over SIR
description: The Election Commission of India addressed concerns regarding differing opinions among its members during the Special Intensive Revision process. It emphasised that such differences are normal in decision-making and all final decisions are taken unanimously. The Commission criticised media reports highlighting isolated internal notes while neglecting overall approvals and initiatives. Opposition leaders have intensified their criticism, alleging that the revision targets specific elector groups favorable to the BJP.

title: Kalkaji gangrape sparks Delhi-wide park safety audit including presence of Pink Police
description: Delhi lieutenant governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu has ordered a safety audit of all city parks. This follows the gangrape of a 17-year-old girl at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Authorities have been directed to enhance lighting, security, and regular patrolling measures in these parks. Pink Police personnel will be deployed to improve safety during vulnerable hours at public locations.

title: A kidney wait since 2024 ends with an Army airlift and a rare double transplant
Widow gets job after husband's death; Rajasthan HC orders 25% salary to mother-in-law
description: A widow employed through a compassionate appointment must allocate part of her salary to her mother-in-law. The Rajasthan high court acknowledged that the widow halted financial support after remarrying. She initially committed to providing for her family when applying for the position. The court's decision mandates that 25 percent of her salary be deducted for the elderly mother.

title: After 28 years, Mirabai Chanu finally puts India back on Asian Games weightlifting podium
description: With India's hopes resting on her shoulders, the Tokyo Olympic silver medallist Mirabai Chanu lifted 198kg to win silver in the women's 49kg event at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya. It was India's first Asian Games weightlifting medal since Karnam Malleswari won silver at the 1998 Bangkok Games.

title: Quote of the day by Meg Ryan
description: Meg Ryan emphasizes the vital role that small acts of kindness can play in uplifting mothers and children worldwide. During a visit to New Light in Kolkata, she gained a deeper understanding of the struggles faced by many. Ryan urges individuals to get involved in various capacities, stressing that support can take forms beyond finances. By ensuring access to essential healthcare and education, modest contributions can profoundly enhance lives.

title: 'This is treason': Rahul revives 'vote chori' charge after report of rift within EC
description: Rahul Gandhi has leveled grave accusations against the Election Commission, claiming treason in the wake of the electoral roll revision process. These accusations arose after a report revealed dissent among Election Commissioners. Veteran Congress leaders echoed this sentiment, urging a parliamentary review. In response, the Election Commission refuted any internal conflicts, asserting that all decisions were made collectively and in strict adherence to legal protocols and Supreme Court directives.

title: Banks to open on Sunday ahead of 3-day nationwide strike: What customers should know
description: Banks will remain open on Sunday, September 27, to ensure public access to essential services and mitigate disruptions. The United Forum of Bank Unions plans a nationwide strike from September 28 to 30 due to ongoing demands. Customers could face a five-day disruption in services, as the strike follows a weekend holiday. Key demands include the introduction of five-day banking and improvements in pension schemes for employees.

title: Trump-Xi summit: $14 billion Taiwan arms deal hangs over Washington talks
Half-burnt body of woman found in UP, toddler found crying nearby
description: On Wednesday morning, a half-burnt body of a woman was discovered in a sugarcane field. Nearby, her nearly 18-month-old daughter was found crying and in need of care. The police suspect the woman was strangled before her body was transported to the field. Authorities are attempting to identify the woman and investigate the circumstances surrounding her death.

title: Rats filmed running across tables at Rajkot McDonald's, civic body takes action
description: In Rajkot, a customer recorded a video of two rats in a McDonald's outlet. The civic food department confirmed the incident and conducted an inspection of the restaurant. Following the findings, an administrative charge of Rs 3,000 was imposed on the establishment. This action was part of a larger drive against food adulteration and unhygienic practices in the city.

title: IIT-Bombay on boil: Professor sent on leave, student's parents 'driven' out of city
description: Sahil Wakode's parents were allegedly taken out of Mumbai against their wishes by unidentified individuals. They plan to start a hunger strike for justice outside IIT-Bombay, demanding prompt arrests. The Mumbai Crime Branch is investigating the circumstances surrounding Sahil's death. Allegations suggest caste-based discrimination contributed to the student's distress before his tragic death. The family expresses their determination for a fair investigation and accountability for those involved.

title: India's urban housing story: Over 1 cr homes completed, more families targeted
Tasmania treated invasive grass; fish species more than doubled in 3 years
description: Tasmania’s Duck Bay wetland is showing signs of recovery after years of work to remove invasive rice grass. Circular Head Landcare has reduced the weed from about 50 hectares to five, allowing native saltmarsh plants to return. University of Tasmania scientists found fish species increased from five to 11, with yellow-eye mullet and other species returning to restored areas.

title: Russian oligarch’s wedding gift to Trump Jr puts family dealings under scrutiny
description: Senator John Curtis has called for a thorough Senate investigation into Donald Trump Jr's financial ties to a Russian oligarch amid mounting concerns of potential corruption linked to Umar Kremlev's extravagant wedding celebration. This move seeks to ensure that Trump Jr's foreign business dealings are examined fairly, especially as political dynamics shift ahead of the midterm elections.

title: ‘Want to see him under pressure’: NZ coach's challenge for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
description: Rob Walter has shown great enthusiasm in witnessing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's adaptation to the challenging playing conditions of New Zealand. This T20I series will be Sooryavanshi's inaugural experience on the bouncy pitches of New Zealand, which promises to be enlightening. Walter, the head coach, believes that facing pressure is vital for player development, especially as New Zealand makes its T20I return after a tough World Cup final loss.

title: Operation Sindoor lessons baked in to IAF's multilateral Tarang Shakti wargames
description: The multi-nation air exercise Tarang Shakti will take place at the Indian Air Force base in Jodhpur. Scheduled from September 26 to October 11, the exercise will involve around 40 countries. The Indian Air Force aims to integrate lessons from Operation Sindoor into training scenarios during the drills. This training will include various air operations involving advanced aircraft and combat scenarios.

title: Paid Rs 84,960 for '100% placement guarantee', got no job: MBA graduate wins refund
description: A district consumer commission in Punjab has mandated Eduinx Education Services to refund Rs 84,960 to an MBA graduate. This decision arose after the company was unable to deliver on its promise of guaranteed placement. Harish Malhotra, the complainant, sought compensation due to the company’s failure to fulfill its representation. The commission determined that Eduinx's claims constituted unfair trade practices.

title: 'Strategic desperation': Iran on Trump's 'annihilate Islamic Republic' remark
description: Iranian military authorities said Trump's remarks showed the difficulties facing the US in its confrontation with Iran. They argued that repeated threats were not evidence of American strength, but reflected what they described as exhaustion within the US military. The statement also accused the US of creating instability in West Asia through its military presence in the region.

title: Simon Cowell to miss America’s Got Talent finale over health concerns
description: Simon Cowell will not participate in America’s Got Talent Season 21 finale as he recovers from surgery. His absence opens up his spot for YouTuber KSI, who will be a guest judge. KSI will join judges Howie Mandel, Sofia Vergara, and Mel B during the performances and results episode. Simon's health issues led to guest judges filling in while he was away.

title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

title: 'White House access privilege, not right': DOJ backs Trump barring reporters
description: The Trump administration has claimed the authority to restrict access for journalists to the White House. It argues that access is a privilege and not a right, citing national security concerns. The Justice Department emphasizes that First Amendment rights do not guarantee access to the complex. In response, CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are challenging these restrictions in federal court.

title: South Africa mass shooting: At least 11 killed by unidentified gunman in Durban
Nationwide strike : Banks to remain shut for three days - what customers need to know
description: Bank unions are gearing up for a three-day nationwide strike from September 28 to 30, potentially halting banking services and creating a five-day interruption for customers due to the preceding weekend holiday. Key banking activities, including half-yearly closings, will coincide with this period, heightening concerns about accessibility. Customers are encouraged to leverage digital services and finish any in-branch transactions before the strike.

title: Peacemaker with a warning to annihilate: The major contradictions in Trump's UN speech
description: Trump used much of his address to the General Debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly to list his achievements, much as he did a year ago when he cast himself as the standout contender for the Nobel Peace Prize. This year, though, the prize went unmentioned. Instead, his tone hardened, with attacks on the International Criminal Court (ICC), the UN's climate agenda and Unesco.

title: Karnataka man murdered in UAE, body cut into 9 pieces; wife, son untraceable
description: A man from Kundapur, Alwin, was reported missing after last contacting his family in July. His family became suspicious after receiving unusual text messages from his phone, which he rarely used. After his body was discovered in Sharjah, they received a death certificate and filed various complaints. Alwin's wife and son remain uncontactable amid ongoing investigations. Udupi police await official confirmation of the incident from relevant authorities.

title: Gwalior teen raped by 17-year-old neighbour on day of Jamui horror
description: A Class 10 student in Bihar was molested on the same day a Gwalior girl was raped. The Gwalior girl, 16, was approached by her 17-year-old neighbor who blackmailed her with private photos. After forcing her to a flat, he allegedly raped her and later released her. The accused had previously stalked her and threatened her with the morphed images.

title: How 3 men posing as cops turned 17-year-old’s birthday outing into a nightmare
description: A 17-year-old girl from Faridabad was allegedly raped by three men in Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Temple, she and her male friend entered the park and faced intimidation. The men, posing as police, threatened to inform their parents about their actions. During the incident, the men physically assaulted the girl's friend before taking her to a secluded area.

title: 'Stalked, hit deliberately': Delhi woman claims bikers chased her scooty before crash
description: A 21-year-old woman reported being stalked and harassed by two men on a motorcycle in South Delhi. While riding home on her scooter, they allegedly hit her vehicle, causing her to fall. The incident resulted in her suffering injuries as she skidded on the road. Police have registered an FIR and initiated an investigation into the matter. CCTV footage reviewed did not reveal the alleged incident or the individuals involved.

title: Trump to increase presence with two ‘very big’ military bases in Greenland
Back home on leave, army man 'beaten to death' by drunk youths in road rage
description: Six individuals were arrested and sent to judicial custody for allegedly killing a soldier from the Assam Regiment. The soldier, Zakaria Lalhriattluanga, was attacked after arriving in Mizoram following his posting in Jammu and Kashmir. This incident occurred near Bualpui village following an altercation over poor road conditions. The accused include both adults and minors, with two minors placed in juvenile custody.
